column1: # 火焰纹章 Engage（Switch，基础版 v0 + 更新 2.0.0 = v327680）的游戏档案。Mac 上能到标题画面；NVN 句柄表按全库着色器实测，内存分区为 Mac 起机所设

# Game profile of Fire Emblem Engage (Switch, base game v0 + update 2.0.0 = v327680). It reaches the title screen on the Mac; the NVN handle tables are measured over all its shaders, the memory partition is set for Mac bring-up
# 格式见 dm/games/README.md | Format: see dm/games/README.md

# Unity 2020.3.18f1（IL2CPP），SDK 12.3.7：着色器是 UnityFS 包与 data.unity3d 里的 Shader 对象（shader_split.py 经 unityfs.py 读出） | Unity 2020.3.18f1 (IL2CPP), SDK 12.3.7: the shaders are Shader objects in UnityFS bundles and data.unity3d (read by shader_split.py through unityfs.py)
# 只解了合并 2.0.0 的那份；基础版单独的构建号用到时再补 | only the merged 2.0.0 copy is extracted; the base game's own build IDs are added when needed
# 装载顺序同 Horizon：main、subsdk*、sdk（subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie） | load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# 原版设出图间隔 2（Switch 上 30 帧）。2.0.0 main 有一处改写剪口（patch_nso.py，QualitySettings.set_vSyncCount 只能设 1），走游戏自己的 60 帧路径：
# 按帧计数的逻辑都按 GameTime.VsyncFixedCount（= vSyncCount）步进，计数 1、60 帧时速度与原版 30 帧相同。于是游戏自己设间隔 1，game 模式给 60 帧。
# Mac 实测（存档列表按住下 0.45 秒）：剪口 60 帧与原版 30 帧都移 6 格；不剪而用 DM_PRESENT_INTERVAL=display 强出 60 帧时移到底（≥9 格），即按帧计数的逻辑加速
# The original sets present interval 2 (30 fps on the Switch). A rewriter cut on 2.0.0 main (patch_nso.py, QualitySettings.set_vSyncCount can only set 1) takes the game's own 60 fps path:

# frame-counted logic steps by GameTime.VsyncFixedCount (= vSyncCount), so a count of 1 at 60 fps runs at the speed of the original at 30 fps. The game then sets interval 1 itself and game mode gives 60 fps.

# Measured on the Mac (holding Down for 0.45 s in the save list): 60 fps with the cut and the original 30 fps both move 6 slots; without the cut, 60 fps forced by DM_PRESENT_INTERVAL=display reaches the end (9 or more), i.e. frame-counted logic speeds up
# NPDM 声明系统资源 16 MB，所以 IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled 为真：nninitStartup 把整个空闲内存（应用池 − 64 MB）作虚拟地址内存交给 StandardAllocator，
# 在别名区里一次分一整块地址区域（按 1 GB 对齐）。Unity 的低层虚拟分配器也自己 AllocateAddressRegion（每块按尺寸对齐，2.25 MB 占 4 MB、16.25 MB 占 20 MB），
# 序章战斗时约 1.05 GB。较新 SDK 的 AddressRegionManager 先占别名区开头约 1 GB 作节点区；patch_nso.py 给本作 sdk 构建登记了剪口，把它缩到 62 MB（真机别名区 64 GB，不在乎这点）。
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is true: nninitStartup hands all free memory (application pool − 64 MB) to StandardAllocator as virtual address memory,

# one address region in the alias region (1 GB aligned). Unity's low-level virtual allocator also calls AllocateAddressRegion itself (each block aligned by size: 2.25 MB takes 4 MB, 16.25 MB takes 20 MB),

# about 1.05 GB in the prologue battle. Newer SDKs' AddressRegionManager first takes about 1 GB at the start of the alias region as its node area; patch_nso.py registers a cut for this game's sdk build that shrinks it to 62 MB (the hardware's alias region is 64 GB and does not care).
# 实测（序章到战斗，12 分钟）：StandardAllocator 只提交 0.58 GB，Unity 自己的区域提交 0.97 GB，合计 1.55 GB。所以应用池报 2.5 GB（StandardAllocator 约 2.44 GB，是用量的 4 倍），
# 整块就能放进 5 GB = 前置 256 MB + 别名区 4.375 GB + 栈区 256 MB + 堆区 128 MB（Engage 不调 SetHeapSize，线程栈在栈区里随机放）。5 GB 是真机跑通过的总量（D2R）；
# iOS 不带「扩展虚拟寻址」授权时单块最多 6 GB，但 Metal 等还要地址（Mac 上 Engage 的显存分配约 1 GB），原先的 6 GB 块在手机上没有余量。

# Measured (prologue to the battle, 12 minutes): StandardAllocator commits only 0.58 GB and Unity's own regions 0.97 GB, 1.55 GB in all. So the pool is reported as 2.5 GB (StandardAllocator about 2.44 GB, four times its use),

# and the block fits in 5 GB = 256 MB in front + 4.375 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 128 MB heap region (Engage never calls SetHeapSize; thread stacks are placed at random in the stack region). 5 GB is the total proven on a phone (D2R);

# without the "extended virtual addressing" entitlement iOS allows one reservation of at most 6 GB, but Metal and the rest need address space too (Engage allocates about 1 GB of GPU memory on the Mac), so the former 6 GB block left no margin on a phone.
# ---- NVN 驱动常量段（dmsh_build.py 出包、nvn_mtl.m 运行时现填；按全库着色器实测） | NVN driver constant segments (dmsh_build.py at packaging, nvn_mtl.m filled at run time; measured over all shaders) ----
# 旧驱动布局（同 D2R）：c2 贴图句柄表 0x168 + 8 r（128 槽）、分离采样器表 0x568 + 8 r；Unity 只用分离贴图 / 采样器（BindSeparateTexture / Sampler）。图像表与 c0 存储缓冲表未实测，先沿用

# Older driver layout (as D2R): c2 texture handle table 0x168 + 8 r (128 slots), separate sampler table 0x568 + 8 r; Unity uses only separate textures / samplers (BindSeparateTexture / Sampler). The image table and the c0 storage buffer table are not measured yet and stay as they were
# ---- 着色器拆分（shader_split.py；Unity Shader 对象，读法见 unityfs.py） | Shader split (shader_split.py; Unity Shader objects, read by unityfs.py) ----

# 引擎自带（data.unity3d、Resources/unity default resources）归 engine，Addressables 资源包归 assets | engine built-ins (data.unity3d, Resources/unity default resources) go to engine, the Addressables bundles to assets
